fitReason: Good applied HRI/software fit through explanation, language interfaces and evaluating expressive robot communication. The inspected recent implementation is an offline LLM-to-robot storytelling pipeline, so this is a more moderate robot-learning fit than labs training embodied control or perception policies.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full HRI Companion 2026 paper A Pilot Study of Robot Storytelling for Civic Data Literacy reports a physical Misty II deployment at a New York public event in November 2025. GPT-5 generated narratives and behavior cues from processed civic-data summaries; authors checked claims and adapted cues to robot capabilities. Four prerecorded scripts used speech, face/LED changes and head/arm motion. Six adults completed the interaction and survey. This verifies AI-assisted physical HRI, not online LLM dialogue, learned motor control or autonomous adaptation.

shortVisit.summary: Current official faculty pages establish a public contact and lab leadership, but no external short-term master's visitor invitation was verified. The lab website required a CAPTCHA in the cloud browser and was not inspected beyond that block. Degree-oriented recruitment and local undergraduate research cohorts are not counted as external summer opportunities.

scoreReasons.fit: clear applied language/HRI overlap, with weaker learned-control/perception evidence in the inspected deployment.
scoreReasons.physical: named Misty II, concrete head/arm behavior, real public deployment and primary methods.
scoreReasons.freshness: March 2026 primary paper with explicitly dated November 2025 deployment. Provisional evidence-fit score, not acceptance probability or prestige.
